The call was answered by management. Here is the established pathway:

**Channel:** Parking changes — including requesting a second assigned space — go through the **resident portal only**. That is the sole route management uses for parking assignments, fob changes, and lease elections. Email and phone are for maintenance requests and general inquiries.

**Rate already set:** The lease renewal states *"units with more than one registered vehicle pay $60 per additional space."* So the $60/month figure is already on the books — no rate negotiation needed.

**What needs to happen:** You or Marcus log into the resident portal and submit a parking-change request for a second assigned space for Unit 4B. The portal support desk exists but is inside the portal itself — it is not reachable externally.

If neither of you has the portal credentials or the request form is unclear, the management office ((555) 014-2200, Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00) can walk you through it by phone.
